mu_name: The blue swirl a Kanturu Blade Hunter's blow throws
why_this_one: MODEL_BLADE_SKILL, which AttackEffectKanturu1stMonster creates 140 units out from the hunter's BLADE_L_HAND at CheckAttackTime(14) (GM_Kanturu_1st.cpp:716-740). game/fx/blade_hunter.h draws it.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Effect/bladetonedo.bmd, from MuMain's clean Data: one mesh, 156 vertices, 160 triangles on shockwave.jpg; about 0.8 m round and lying 1.8 m back from its origin along MU's y.

parts.note: Data/Effect/shockwave.OZJ: a grey ring of streaks on black. Drawn RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT three times over at BodyLight (0.2, 0.2, 1.0) (ZzzObject.cpp:1669-1674).

scale_from: Scale 1.5 at its birth, down 0.1 a frame to 0.8; LifeTime 10 (ZzzEffect.cpp:521-530, MoveHandlers.cpp:331-341).
